title: Drug Addicts by Highest Education Level
description: The dataset provides information on drug addicts categorized by their highest level of education. The data is collected by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (NADA) through various treatment and rehabilitation centers across Malaysia. It includes yearly data at both national and state levels.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: The date representing the year of data collection, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: The state in Malaysia where the data was collected. It includes individual states and the national level (Malaysia).

fields.name: education
fields.title: Education Level
fields.description: The highest level of education attained by the drug addicts. Categories include 'none', 'primary', 'pmr', 'spm', 'stpm', 'tertiary', and 'others'.

fields.name: addicts
fields.title: Number of Addicts
fields.description: The total number of drug addicts recorded for each education level and state.

methodology: The data is compiled annually by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (NADA) from records at various treatment and rehabilitation centers throughout Malaysia. Each entry in the dataset represents the number of drug addicts identified within a given year, categorized by their highest level of education and the state in which they were recorded.
caveat: The dataset is based on administrative records from NADA's treatment centers and may not capture all cases of drug addiction within the community. The education level is self-reported by the individuals and may not be verified. Additionally, the data does not account for individuals who may have relapsed or those who have not sought treatment.
